title: The Toll of the Seven Gates
text: Seven gates stand open in the hillside, each lower than the last, each colder. At the seventh, a crowned god of plague sits among the dead, and the dead do not seem to mind. He offers you health against every sickness the world holds, for a toll.

options.label: Kneel among the dead and pay his toll, for health against every plague.

outcomes.text: The fevers of the world will pass you by. In return, the god keeps a Year from each of you, folded away somewhere below.

options.label: Refuse him, here at the seventh gate, among his willing dead.

outcomes.text: He rises from his throne of the dead, far larger standing than he seemed seated.

options.label: Take his blessing and leave the toll bowl empty, trusting the dead to look away.

outcomes.text: The Leader takes the blessing and spits in the toll bowl. The god only smiles, as if he expected nothing less.
The toll takes itself, quietly, from each of you. The god does not even look up.
